{{Quote|You know, all Star Tours flights are non-smoking. And just so you know, that applies to luggage as well.|G2-9T|<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>}}
A specialized device that emits '''smoke'''. It harbored a unique design resembling a gravy saucer with a top, and sometimes emits smoke from the funnel. It was used for [[Smoking/Legends|smoking]] purposes.

One such device was brought on board [[Spaceport THX1138]], and was eventually discovered by the baggage check droid [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]]. Despite the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency's strict non-smoking policy (to the extent of it even applying to luggage as well), the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] cleared it to be brought aboard a Star Tours flight.

==Behind the scenes==
The item appeared in a luggage x-ray scan in the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride at [[Disneyland]] and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]]. The item was actually supposed to be the Genie's magic lamp from the Disney film [[Wikipedia:Aladdin (1992 Disney film)|''Aladdin'']], although G2-9T's comment implied that it was used for smoking.
